scope: CalBench opt-in evaluation; production active unchanged

contract.usage_contract: required nonnegative integer completion_tokens from provider; includes reasoning tokens when provider counts them in completion_tokens; do not add reasoning tokens twice
contract.budget_failure: abort without executing an action if usage is missing/invalid, cap exceeded, or no action budget remains
contract.budget_scope: output-token cap, not matched FLOPs or input tokens
contract.ms_memory: no independent MS history; native final assistant responses remain in native history
contract.request_layout: native messages byte-for-byte unchanged; append separate user MS prompt; continue exact prefix with actual assistant MS response then user action prompt
contract.persistence: temporary stage messages never mutate native history; return only final action response to original client for its original persistence policy
contract.analysis_failure: abort game/run on empty, truncated, unfinished or non-stop MS; no fallback
contract.action_failure: retain native parsing/retry policy; do not erase failed attempts
contract.seed_policy: action uses original native seed sequence; MS uses SHA256(native seed:ms)
contract.privacy: only native visible messages; MS is private and never executed

resolved_transport.context_policy: no adapter truncation; server rejects oversized requests
